runtime.title: DOSBox

settings.title: Settings
settings.showTrivia: Show a fun fact in the library
settings.showTriviaHint: A different Commander Keen fun fact on each start. They may or may not be true.
settings.rerunHint: Download DOSBox and the free episodes, or add games from Steam and GOG.
settings.autoBackupHint: BloogBase backs up your saves before every game start. The backup stays only if you overwrite a save while playing; the old version then shows up with that save.
settings.keepBackups: Automatic backups to keep per game
settings.backupsHint: Backups you make yourself are never removed automatically. BloogBase also backs up before restoring or deleting a save.
settings.keenwikiCacheHint: BloogBase keeps the KeenWiki pages it reads for a day. If a page has changed since, for example a fixed download link, delete them so it reads it again.
settings.nextStart: What you set for the games applies from their next start.
settings.fullscreenHint: BloogBase in fullscreen covers the taskbar, and every game started from it goes fullscreen too. F11 switches BloogBase anytime, Alt+Enter a running game.
settings.fullscreenHint_mac: BloogBase in fullscreen covers the Dock and the menu bar, and every game started from it goes fullscreen too. ⌃⌘F switches BloogBase anytime, ⌥ option+↩ return a running game.
settings.fullscreenOverridden: Whether games start in fullscreen is set by your DOSBox settings for all games (below); while BloogBase is in fullscreen, they do anyway.

displayHint.crt: Shows the games as on a monitor of the time, with scanlines and soft pixels. Turned off, pixels stay sharp.
displayHint.vsync: Helps if the picture tears horizontally while moving. Controls then react a tiny bit later; not needed on FreeSync or G-Sync monitors.
displayHint.all: Fullscreen, the CRT effect and VSync can differ for individual games, on their page under “DOSBox & patches”.

settings.displayOverridden: Set by your DOSBox settings for all games (below).
settings.inactiveLabel: When you switch to another window
settings.inactiveHint: A paused game goes on as soon as you switch back to its window.
settings.legacyPcOption: Hard disk noises and slower loading
settings.legacyPcHint: Games load as slowly as from a hard disk of the time, and you hear it seek and spin.
settings.musicHint: For games with music, also Keen 1–3 mods with their own.
settings.gameSettingsHint: What you set here replaces what was set in the game itself.
settings.oneButtonFiringHint: The key set for Fire, otherwise Space, shoots instead of Ctrl and Alt together, and Enter opens the status window. Shooting with a joystick may stop working. Mods that already do this stay as they are, except for the key; mods that change the controls differently aren’t touched.
settings.oneButtonFiringHint_mac: The key set for Fire, otherwise Space, shoots instead of ⌃ control and ⌥ option together, and ↩ return opens the status window. Shooting with a joystick may stop working. Mods that already do this stay as they are, except for the key; mods that change the controls differently aren’t touched.
settings.controllerLayoutHint: Which buttons your controller has, for the games and the button names in BloogBase. Automatic tells Xbox and PlayStation controllers apart on Windows and Linux; choose one if your controller is taken for the wrong one.
settings.keysIntro: Press a new key for an action. From the next start it replaces what is set in the game; actions with a dash keep each game's key.
settings.keysUnknown: DOS doesn't know this key. Please pick another one.
settings.keysReserved: This key is taken: the games use it themselves.
settings.keysTaken: This key is already set for {{action}}.
settings.keysClash: This key also does something else in the games, unless you move that too.
settings.keysHint: Which keys a game uses is on its page under Controls. Fire in Keen 1–3 needs “one-button firing”; without it, Keen fires with Jump and Pogo together. Keen Dreams has no pogo stick: Fire throws.

patches.title: Custom patches
patches.hint: Patch file lines for this copy of the game, e.g. for another key layout. They come along at every start of this game and of all mods on this copy, after the mod's own lines, and can break mods that change the same places.
patches.example:
One line each, as in a patch file:
%patch $1F2B $90 $90
patches.unpatchable: There are no patches for this version of the game, so you can't add your own here.

bad.reserved: Line {{line}}: BloogBase writes {{word}} itself. Please leave the line out.
bad.value: Line {{line}}: "{{word}}" isn't a number the patcher understands (e.g. $1F, $1F2BW or 31). With this error the patcher would stop every mod on this copy.

patches.edit: Edit them on the game copy

status.applied: This mod gets the custom patches of {{game}}.
status.ownProgram: This mod doesn't get the custom patches of {{game}}: it starts a program of its own.
status.patcherOnly: This mod doesn't get the custom patches of {{game}}: they have lines only the patcher understands, and the mod starts the game without it.
status.packed: This mod doesn't get the custom patches of {{game}}: the game's program is packed in a way BloogBase can't change.

gameStatus.patcherOnly: The game starts without the patcher, so BloogBase only understands %patch and %patchfile lines here. The patches are skipped; mods with a patch file still get them.
gameStatus.packed: The game's program is packed in a way BloogBase can't change. The patches are skipped; mods with a patch file still get them.

about.title: About BloogBase
about.tagline: A cozy home for Commander Keen: play the games and the community's mods with a single click.
about.author: Made by <profile>{{name}}</profile>
about.authorProfile: Open profile on the PCKF forum
about.diagnosticsHint: A report helps with finding a problem. It has the versions, your games, the game you played last and the end of the logs; personal paths are taken out. Nothing is sent without you.
about.diagnosticsPaste: Paste the report into the issue and describe the problem.
about.trademark: Commander Keen is a trademark of id Software. BloogBase is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by id Software, ZeniMax Media, Apogee or Softdisk. All other names and trademarks belong to their owners.
about.noGameData: BloogBase contains no game data. The free shareware episodes are downloaded unchanged from public archives; everything else comes from your own copies. Mods are downloaded from their authors' original sources.
about.thanksText: To the Keen community, whose mods, research and documentation make all of this possible, and to the mod authors credited on every mod's page.
about.license: BloogBase is free software under the MIT license.
about.dosbox: Games run in DOSBox Staging {{version}}, which BloogBase downloads from its official releases and starts as a separate program. DOSBox Staging is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later; its source code is available from the DOSBox Staging project.
about.cwsdpmi: Mods with DJGPP programs get CWSDPMI r7 put next to them, unmodified. CWSDPMI is Copyright © 1995–2010 Charles W. Sandmann. You have the right to receive the source code and updates of CWSDPMI.
about.ckpatch: Mods that need CKPatch but don’t include it get it put next to them, unmodified: CKPatch 0.10 for Keen 1–6, KDrPatch 0.9.0 for Keen Dreams. CKPatch is Copyright © Bryan Rodgers and Andrew Durdin, KDrPatch is MultiMania’s version of it; both are licensed under the GNU GPL 2.0.
about.fonts: Fonts: Inter and Press Start 2P, both under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Icons: Lucide (ISC license).
